name: VOF Advection with Isosurface Extraction
aliases: Volume of Fluid (VOF) Advection with Isosurface Extraction
definition: A method for simulating multiphase fluid flows using VOF, where the indicator function χ is integrated over cells. The interface is reconstructed using PLIC (Piecewise Linear Interface Calculation) methods, and the isosurface extraction procedure estimates the PLIC interface orientation.
